name: Open-Faced Curried Tofu Salad Sandwiches with Lettuce & Cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, nutritional yeast, Dijon, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl; stir to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup vegan mayonnaise
⅓ cup nutritional yeast flakes
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp curry powder
salt
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp turmeric, ground
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl with the dressing; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu mixture.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the tofu mixture.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the tofu salad and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and salt. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two baking sheets and drizzle with garlic oil. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide toast between plates; top with lettuce, tofu salad, and cucumber slices. Season cucumber with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
